newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine Q1 public sector deficit 7.1 bln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Philippine Q1 public sector deficit 7.1 bln pesos.

text.p: The Philippine public sector deficit stood at 7.1 billion pesos in the first quarter of the year, the Department of Finance said on Monday.
The deficit is line with the government's target. No comparative figures were immediately available.
The consolidated public sector includes the fiscal position of the national government, the Central Bank, government owned and controlled corporations, local government units and state pension funds.
A finance official said he expected the public sector financial position to turn into a surplus in the second quarter due to seasonally high collections.

However, preliminary figures from the Bureau of Treasury showed the national government budget surplus had dwindled in the first five months of the year to 4.2 billion pesos from 18.2 billion as of end-April.
